# id: # Hunter methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Natural History Quiz (Varrock Museum)
where: Varrock Museum basement (talk to Orlando Smith)
note: One-time reward of 1,000 Hunter XP (the UIM guide also gives 1,000 Slayer XP), enough for level 9; no per-hour rate; members flag not stated on the pages.
source: OSRS Wiki Hunter training; Ironman Guide/Hunter; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hunter 2026-11-11

name: Bird house trapping (Fossil Island)
note: Hunter XP/h is the wiki's effective rate at 45 runs/h (4 houses per run), keyed to the Hunter level needed to place each tier; seeds and logs/h are our estimate; each tier needs its own Crafting level (5 to 90); the UIM guide's mounted-pendant rates differ (38,400 to 164,600).
source: OSRS Wiki Hunter training; Ironman Guide/Hunter; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hunter 2026-11-11

name: Catching feldip weasels
note: Ironman guide says around 13,000 Hunter XP/h from level 9 to 13, before desert devils; several rings of pursuit are used; members flag not stated on the pages.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Hunter; Hunter training 2026-11-11

name: Catching desert devils (Uzer)
note: Ironman guide says around 18,500 Hunter XP/h from 13 to 25; bring 6 to 7 full waterskins for the heat; members flag not stated on the pages.

name: Catching ruby harvests and copper longtails
note: Up to 20,000 Hunter XP/h with two traps when butterflies are combined (Ironman guide); birds alone give little XP; the UIM guide gives 17,000 to 18,000/h with snares; members flag inferred.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Hunter; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hunter 2026-11-11

name: Catching sapphire glacialis butterflies
note: Ironman guide gives 28,500 Hunter XP/h at level 25; drop the net from level 35 for better catch rates (unless a magic butterfly net); the page's member table marks this area as members.

name: Catching embertailed jerboas
note: Ironman guide says 3 box traps reach 50,000 Hunter XP/h; partial completion of Eagles' Peak is needed to set box traps; members flag inferred.

name: Catching swamp lizards
where: Swamp hunter area (location not in fetched text)
note: UIM guide gives 20,000 to 25,000 Hunter XP/h from 29 to 40 and 40,000 to 54,000 from 40 to 59 with three traps; it suggests three of each net and rope past level 40; members flag inferred.

name: Falconry for kebbits
where: Piscatoris falconry area (fairy ring AKQ, then east)
note: Ironman guide gives the lower end of 60,000 to 70,000 for spotted kebbits (43 to 57), 75,000 to 80,000 for dark kebbits (57+) and 85,000 to 95,000 for dashing kebbits (69+); a gyr falcon rental costs 500 coins and weapon, shield and hand slots must be empty; members flag inferred.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Hunter; Hunter training 2026-11-11

name: Tracking razor-backed kebbits
where: Piscatoris hunter area (fairy ring AKQ, then east)
note: Hunter training gives up to 130,000 Hunter XP/h, about 100,000 without stamina potions (from a summary of truncated text, verify); members flag inferred.

name: Catching red salamanders
where: Red salamander area near Khazard Battlefield (UIM guide route)
note: UIM guide gives 80,000 to 85,000 Hunter XP/h at level 60 and 100,000 to 105,000 at 69; it suggests five ropes and nets plus weight-reducing gear; members flag inferred.

name: Hunters' Rumours (Hunter Guild)
note: Unlock levels are 46 (Novice), 57 (Adept), 72 (Expert) and 91 (Master); rates are the Hunter training page's pre-99 figures (from a summary, verify), while the UIM guide quotes over 150,000/h at 72 and 220,000/h at 91; AT_FIRST_LIGHT is needed for Master rumours.
source: OSRS Wiki Hunter training; Ironman Guide/Hunter; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hunter 2026-11-11

name: Maniacal monkeys
where: Maniacal monkey area (traps set while riding a stunted demonic gorilla)
note: UIM guide gives 50,000 to 65,000 Hunter XP/h at 60 and up to 120,000 at 99, with 1,000 XP per monkey; it calls this one of the least efficient ways to 99 Hunter as a UIM because it yields no usable supplies.

name: Catching carnivorous (red) chinchompas
where: Gwenith Hunter area (Prifddinas) or red chinchompa hunting ground
note: UIM guide's lower-end rates use tick manipulation; Song of the Elves needs 70 Hunter, and the hard Western Provinces Diary is the alternative from 69; the Ironman guide advises getting 80 Hunter from bird houses first; partial Eagles' Peak is needed for any chinchompa.
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hunter; Ironman Guide/Hunter; Hunter training 2026-11-11

name: Tracking herbiboars
where: Herbiboar area (location not stated in these guides)
note: Ironman guide gives 115,000 to 130,000 Hunter XP/h depending on Hunter level and the UIM guide gives 120,000 to 150,000; Herblore 85 is recommended for better herbs but not required; members flag inferred.
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Hunter; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Hunter; Hunter training 2026-11-11

name: Catching black chinchompas (Wilderness)
note: Rates are the solo (no alt account) figures from the Hunter training table; alt-account rates are higher (157,000 at 73 to 265,000 at 99); the Ironman guide says hardcore ironmen cannot realistically hunt them; the 75 Defence/Magic minimums and knife come from a summary of the page.
source: OSRS Wiki Hunter training; Ironman Guide/Hunter 2026-11-11
